name: Red XIII, Proud Warrior
oracle_text:
Vigilance, trample
Other modified creatures you control have vigilance and trample. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
Cosmo Memory — When Red XIII enters, return target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: Other modified creatures you control have vigilance and trample

needs.what: the `modified` filter key (has a counter of any kind, OR is equipped by any Equipment, OR is enchanted by an Aura the static's controller controls) accepted in a static ability's `affects` filter, so a `grant_keyword` static can read "other modified creatures you control" continuously
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `modified` exists only in `selector_keys` (effect selectors, `_is_modified` in engine/effects/selectors.py), not in `static_affects_filter_keys`. An `any_of` union in `affects` covers two limbs (`has_counters: true`, `enchanted_by: {controller: you}`) but no static filter key asks whether an Equipment is attached to the creature: `attached` and `attached_to_host` read from the attachment's own end, and `attached_to` filters the host of the source, so the equipped limb would be silently dropped
